_comment: Field parcels referenced by the Cannwood annual monitoring reports. `key` is what table files reference. The import script matches existing DB locations by name or alias (case-insensitive) before creating; created locations get location_type below and no geometry (boundaries drawn later in the admin map).

locations.name: SSSI (2991)
locations.notes: North Brewham Meadows SSSI parcel at Cannwood, adjoining Hicks' Park Wood

locations.name: Field 1417
locations.notes: Meadow west of 2207, alongside Hicks' Park Wood

locations.notes: Large meadow south of Cannwood Lane, retained in the Meadows Management Plan

locations.notes: Eastern strip between Hicks' Park Wood and Cannwood Lane

locations.name: Field 5474
locations.notes: Easternmost strip between Hicks' Park Wood and Cannwood Lane

locations.name: Field 7494 (Animal House)
locations.notes: Received the swimming-pond spoil in 2018; Westerwolds ryegrass then SSSI hay strewing 2019; later part rewilded, part pony paddock

locations.name: Lark Farm 0259
locations.notes: North of Cannwood Lane between Hicks' Park Wood and West End Wood. Printed as 0269 in the 2021 table and 2024 caption, 0259 in the 2023 and 2025 reports; treated as the same field

locations.name: Lark Farm 6046
locations.notes: Grassy field by the farmstead, south of Cannwood Lane

locations.name: Lark Farm 9826
locations.notes: Easternmost docky field with pond near Druly Hill. Printed as 7826 in the 2021 table header, 9826 everywhere else (including the 2021 report's own prose)
